title: Repeatedly interrupted documents stop retrying indefinitely
summary: Documents that repeatedly interrupt processing now stop with an error, allowing other documents to continue. Completed pages are retained during recovery.
bodyMarkdown:
## What changed

After repeated interruptions on the same page or while preparing the result, document processing stops with an error instead of retrying indefinitely. Completed pages are reused when processing resumes.

## Why it matters

One repeatedly interrupted document no longer keeps retrying without an end, and other queued documents can continue processing.

## Where to find it

Check the processing status in **Documents**. A document that cannot finish after repeated interruptions is reported as failed.
